text_block_list.name: Gentleman
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that Lady Fine over there?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You are...! It's been a while. Not since 
we met in Ireland, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
She's in charge of diplomatic affairs in 
Japan. She was also a great help when 
making arrangements for studying abroad.

text_block_list.name: Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
Meeting like this must be fate. We happen 
to be hosting a buffet party at my home 
shortly.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I am grateful for your invitation.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
However, that is not something I can 
decide on my own discretion.

text_block_list.name: Gentleman
text_block_list.text: Oh, I see. Trainer, what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
It's a casual gathering with no dress 
code. As long as it fits both of your 
schedules...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, I am nervous. Remembering 
our past outings that went poorly, I worry 
whether I'll end up causing trouble for 
her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
But—more than that. As her Trainer and no 
one else, this time, I want to be there 
for her...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Would you mind showing me 
the way, then?

text_block_list.name: Gentleman's Wife
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Lady Fine...! It has been quite a 
while. You have grown into a wonderful 
young lady.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Good day. I am so glad to see that Madame 
is doing well as ever, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I knew it already, but her nobility in a 
formal setting is beyond words. Compared 
to her, my sense of not belonging eats 
away at me. But—

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text: I hear you are the lady's Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted to speak with you. Given 
your current track record, what kind of 
path do you intend to walk with them from 
here on out...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This time, I'm going to step up and act 
like her trainer for real...!"

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
I see, there are training methods like 
that too! My niece is an Umamusume, you 
see. She just loves to run... Would you 
mind if I took some notes?

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
No, that was a very intriguing discussion. 
I hope to speak with you again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I managed to pull through somehow... 
Taking advantage of a lull in the 
conversation to slip away, I decided to 
take a break with Fine Motion.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Good work~ ...Wait, huh? Were you more 
nervous than you let on?
choice_data_list:
This time, I wanted to be of help to 
you...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! I think you did great. 
Everyone was complimenting me, too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
But still... there's something that made 
me waaaay happier than the party being a 
success♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...It's that you worked so hard for my 
sake."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Even when you carefully gathered hints and 
helped me with the puzzles so that I could 
enjoy solving them—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Like when she took the lead to make sure 
everyone had fun, wanting it to become a 
wonderful memory!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You've been working hard right by my side 
this entire time. A hard worker like you 
might say that's not true, but—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: This pounding heart is the answer.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you like that makes me so proud... 
It makes me want to work even harder 
together with you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Will you keep doing your best alongside 
me?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's the spirit. That's my Trainer 
for ya!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Just kidding♪

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
Lady Fine, would you care to tell us more 
about your Trainer over here?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yep♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing side by side with her, we 
returned to the circle of people. I 
resolved in my heart that I would keep 
walking alongside her from this spot going 
forward...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
! ...Fufu, so that's how it is, huh? In 
that case, I will—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I have received your heartfelt spirit. 
...Please, allow me to express my 
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Even when I return to my distant homeland, 
all the glorious memories made in Japan 
will never fade —none of this would be 
possible without your devotion.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I look forward to your continued 
devotion. ...My Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her noble voice makes me straighten my 
back. To ensure her days remain brilliant, 
I will continue to support her...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With those feelings held deep in heart, a 
low bow was offered.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You're really tensing up~. Don't 
push yourself—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—No, that will surely be a learning 
experience for us too... right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Just like always!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh~, what kind of impossible 
request should I make~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her smile deepened at the words that had 
slipped out, yet a gentleness seeped 
through her expression... Watching her 
brought a comforting sense of peace.
